item.title: Marks & Spencer Targets Market Share Growth in Denim
item.description: M&S has sold 105,000 pairs of barrel leg jeans since March 2025.

item.title: CBP Cites Customs Bond Insufficiencies As Importers Struggle Under Weight of Tariffs
item.description: More companies than ever aren’t paying enough in customs bonds to guarantee coverage of the Trump administration’s broad and hefty tariffs.

item.title: Circulose Restarts Production at Ortviken Plant
item.description: The rechristened Circulose is reopening its Ortviken plant in Sweden to resume the mass production of its recycled textile pulp.

item.title: True Fit Launches AI Shopping Agent Built on Two Decades of Fit Data
item.description: Up to 70 percent of fashion-related questions asked to AI shopping agents are specifically about fit and sizing, according to True Fit.

item.title: Denim Deal Taps Green Story to Strengthen Digital Product Passports and Circularity Reporting
item.description: Denim Deal announced a new strategic partnership with Green Story.

item.title: Hapag-Lloyd Targets Downcycle Flexibility with $4.2B ZIM Acquisition
item.description: By acquiring ZIM, Hapag-Lloyd increases chartered vessel exposure, a strategy executives say will help adjust capacity and costs during a freight downturn.

item.title: China Grants Duty-Free Access for Nearly All Products From Africa
item.description: Weeks after the United States Congress approved a bill extending the African Growth and Opportunity Act, China’s government has passed its own legislation solidifying trade with 53 African nations.

item.title: Why the EU Just Opened an Investigation Into Shein
item.description: The move came after the discovery of illicit weapons and childlike sex dolls on the Chinese e-tailer's website late last year.

item.title: UPS Calls for Dismissal of Teamsters Lawsuit Over $150K Driver Buyout Plan
item.description: The courier argues courts lack jurisdiction under a decades-old labor law to enjoin UPS from rolling out a voluntary separation program tied to its Amazon glide down.

item.title: Depop Pitches Resale as a Personal Finance Strategy in New U.S. Campaign
item.description: With Kelis and a data-driven hook, the Etsy-owned marketplace's latest ad campaign leans into secondhand as income stream amid financial strain.
